data.description: The pack itself, when small. Exactly one of data and parts is present. Inline so small pushes cost no blob uploads, which hosts rate-limit far more tightly than record writes.

repo.description: The `key` of the dev.knotless.repo this pack belongs to.

tips.description: Hex object IDs the pack holds everything reachable from, short of `bases`.

bases.description: Hex object IDs of objects the pack's history needs and does not hold.

parts.description: The pack, split over blobs in order.

supersedes.description: Record keys of the dev.knotless.pack records this one replaced.

main.description: Keyed `<repo key>.<tid>`, so a newest-first listing from the cursor `<repo key>/` walks one repository's packs in push order. Never updated; compaction writes one pack superseding many and deletes them in the same applyWrites.

description: A self-contained git packfile: every object reachable from `tips` and not from `bases`.
